_comment: All values reproduce from the public files listed in README.md ('Data and splits', 'Results'). Dataset counts: train.csv / dev.csv / test.csv in jd0g/Mistral-NLI-Thoughts (data/original_data). Token statistics: scripts/analysis/analyze_token_lengths.py --train-file data/finetune/train_ft.jsonl --dev-file data/finetune/dev_ft.jsonl --test-file data/original_data/test.csv (token counts are estimated as characters/4, not a tokenizer count). Model metrics: scripts/analysis/compute_test_metrics.py over jd0g/nlistral-7b-results (1,977-row test set, precision/recall/F1 macro-averaged). Token-vs-accuracy: scripts/analysis/analyze_finetuned_results.py on results/nlistral-ablation1-test-labelled.json.

models._comment: Test set = data/original_data/test.csv, 1,977 rows. Precision, recall and F1 are macro-averaged over the two classes.

token_vs_accuracy._comment: Ablation 1 on the 1,977-row test set; reasoning length estimated as characters/4.
